benches.name: lint
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/ot_qkh_ktree_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/ot_qkh_ktree_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qkh_ktree u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_subtiles.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_nearhbm_prod.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv && echo lint-ok
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the 5df61de79 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/ot_qkh_ktree_m5/src]
